replacements.text: The grilling board sent typed answers to the expert seat only when they marked or opened a decision. Now every answer with a note or free text goes to the expert. The board's rules for escalating typed answers can no longer fire. Their code remains.
A typed answer that opens nothing runs at the task effort. On a channel the human moved to the expert, it keeps the heavy effort.

A typed answer reached the expert seat only when it marked or opened a decision. When a typed note had nothing downstream, the fast first seat read it. That conflicted with the spec's seating decision.

Every answer with a note or free text goes to the expert. When nothing is downstream, no impact task is recorded and nothing waits. A typed turn with no task runs at the task effort. It keeps the heavy effort on a channel the human moved to the expert. Three spec passages now say the same.
